_comment: Values that are not CSS variables: read from the real elements in the signed-in snapshots (raw/layout.json and raw/components-computed.json). Every leaf names where it was read.

sidebar-width.source: measured: <nav> width on every desktop page (layout.json)

sidebar-collapsed-width.source: measured: <nav> width after the collapse button or Cmd+. (home-dark-sidebar-collapsed)

header-height.source: measured: the sidebar header row and the page title bar (h-[48px])

content-max-width.source: measured: the task thread and composer column (sm:max-w-[800px])

library-max-width.source: measured: the Library list and tab strip, 370px to 1330px at 1440 wide (layout.json)

phone-width.source: the mobile captures; the drawer is the full 300px sidebar slid in

segment-thumb.source: measured: the sliding thumb of the grid/list segmented control (rounded-[6px]) inside its 8px frame

icon-button.source: measured: the header icon buttons (size-8), the row menu button, the bell and desktop buttons at 28px

avatar.source: measured: the account avatar in the sidebar footer

nav-icon.source: measured: every sidebar glyph (18x18 inside a 20px box)

file-icon.source: measured: the Library row's file-type icon (32x32 in a 40px box)
